# Business Student Society (BSS) at AUB

> The Business Student Society is the student society of the Suliman S. Olayan
> School of Business at the American University of Beirut. Founded in 1965, it
> runs events, workshops, competitions and corporate partnerships, and issues a
> membership card that carries student discounts across Beirut.

Website: https://chaos-961.github.io/bssaub-website/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/businessstudentsociety/
Email: aubbusinesssociety@gmail.com
AUB's own page: https://www.aub.edu.lb/osb/UndergradProgram/Pages/BSS.aspx

Commercial registration number: 5014.

## The membership card

One card gets an AUB student events, opportunities, and discounts with partner
businesses across five categories:

- Restaurants
- Clothing
- Health and beauty
- Fitness
- Services

The society has over 400 active members and more than 50 industry partners.

## The society

**Story.** Founded in 1965 as the Commerce Students' Society, BSS began with a
simple idea: what you learn in class becomes transformative when you apply it.
Today it is led by students across finance, marketing, consulting,
entrepreneurship and management.

**Mission.** To empower business students to grow beyond the classroom,
bridging theory and practice through professional exposure, leadership
opportunities, and a community built on learning, collaboration and career
growth. It does that through events, workshops, competitions and partnerships.

**Vision.** To become the leading platform for business students, fostering
initiative, professionalism and impact, and preparing members to thrive in an
evolving global business environment.

## Questions people actually ask

**What is BSS at AUB?**
The Business Student Society, the student society of the Olayan School of
Business at the American University of Beirut, founded in 1965.

**What does the BSS membership card get me?**
Events, opportunities, and student discounts at partner businesses across
restaurants, clothing, health and beauty, fitness, and services.

**How do I join BSS?**
Get the membership card through the society's website or reach out on Instagram
at @businessstudentsociety.

**Who can join?**
AUB students. The society is run by and for students of the Olayan School of
Business, and the card is aimed at the AUB student body.

**How old is BSS?**
It was founded in 1965 as the Commerce Students' Society, which makes it one of
the older student societies at AUB.

**How many members does BSS have?**
Over 400 active members and more than 50 industry partners.

**Can my business become a BSS sponsor?**
Yes. There is a "Become a sponsor" path on the site for businesses that want to
reach the AUB student body. Email aubbusinesssociety@gmail.com.

**How do I contact BSS?**
Email aubbusinesssociety@gmail.com or message @businessstudentsociety on
Instagram.

## Facts for citation

- Name: Business Student Society. Commonly written BSS, BSS AUB.
- Type: student society, student organisation
- Part of: Suliman S. Olayan School of Business, American University of Beirut
- Founded: 1965 (as the Commerce Students' Society)
- City: Beirut, Lebanon
- Members: 400+ active. Partners: 50+.
- Email: aubbusinesssociety@gmail.com
- CRN: 5014

## Policies

- Privacy: https://chaos-961.github.io/bssaub-website/privacy . A member account holds a name, an
  email address, a search index built from the name, a membership expiry and a created date. The
  password is held by Firebase Authentication and never reaches the society. No analytics of any
  kind runs on the site. No sponsor receives member details.
- Cookies: https://chaos-961.github.io/bssaub-website/cookies . One cookie, bss_member, written
  only after a sign in, holding a display name for the greeting and nothing else. No consent
  banner, because everything stored is needed to run the account the visitor asked for.
- Terms: https://chaos-961.github.io/bssaub-website/terms . Nothing is sold on the site and no
  payment is taken through it, so there is nothing on it to refund. The card is honoured in
  person by the sponsor. Governed by Lebanese law.
